text: 2.10 Validity of IEC a) An IEC allotted to an applicant shall have permanent validity unless suspended/cancelled by the competent authority. The IEC will cover all branches / divisions / units / factories of the applicant. b) IEC’s can however be de-activated in pursuance of the policy in para 2.05(e) of FTP.
